text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, my quiz score was kinda meh. How 
about you, Viv-chan? Perfect score as 
usual?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I flipped through the textbook this 
morning so there wasn't anything I didn't 
get, but—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Wait, WHAAAAT!? Z-Zero points!? No way no 
way no way, WHYYY!?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos-san, please write your name. It's 
the rules, after all..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Aww, no waay~~! Teach, cut me some 
slaaaack!
